info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Operational Services Issued Device Administration By Issued Device Administration Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Issued Device Administration Update API allows organizations to modify the details of specific issued devices within their banking operational services. By utilizing the unique identifier for each issued device, businesses can update device settings, configurations, or statuses efficiently. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions managing a fleet of devices for secure transactions. Typical consumers include system administrators and IT personnel responsible for device management and operational integrity.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of an issued device identified by RES-100045. Ensure you provide all required fields when making the update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to modify the properties of the issued device administration specified by RES-100045. Ensure that the fields you want to update are included in the payload.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the device information has been updated.
